about_the_game:
Welcome Back to Bliss Valley!

You're taking an extended vacation in the wonderful town of Bliss Valley, ready to enjoy all the amenities your hotel has to offer. A friend recommends that you check out the sights, sounds, and attractions of downtown Bliss Valley. The leisure district is full of unique locations to explore, interesting people to meet, and activities to dive into!

Bliss Valley: After Dark is a choose-your-own-adventure-style visual novel RPG. While on your quest to meet and romance the anthro locals of downtown Bliss Valley, you'll encounter a variety of dialogue options and quests. Level up your stats to increase your chances of success throughout your journey.

HEDONISM
Want to focus on romance and lust? The Hedonism stat is for you! With high Hedonism, the gorgeous locals of Bliss Valley will be begging to get into bed with you.

WRATH
Like to solve problems with your fists? Try the Wrath stat. With enough Wrath, no one will dare to cross you.

PRIDE
Prefer playing charismatic characters? Pride is your go-to stat. You know what you want—and you know how to get it.

AVARICE
Want money to never be an issue? Invest in the Avarice stat. It dictates how much cash you start the game with!

CHAOS
Want to play by your own rules? Chaos is your stat! Chaotic choices are high-risk, high-reward.

  • No AI Art/Dialogue/Music

  • Stat Customization

  • Engaging Dialogue Trees

  • Original Soundtrack

  • Choices & Outcomes

  • Multiple Characters to Romance & Seduce

  • Diverse Locations to Explore

  • Multiple Storylines

  • Multiple Endings

  • RPG Elements

How will you spend your vacation in Bliss Valley: After Dark?



This game contains explicit sexual content.
All characters depicted are over the age of 21.
